test_title: PYST 12: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 15th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the related word from the given alternatives.

Law : Justice :: Medicine : ??
solution:
• The relationship is Law is concerned with Justice.
 
• Similarly, Medicine is concerned with Health.
 
• **Law : Justice :: Medicine : Health**
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
